raw_ocr_text:
LAND AND PREMISES situate in the Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden and State of New Jersey as follows:

BEGINNING at a point in the Southeasterly line of Kings Highway West, distant 80.00 feet Southwestwardly from the intersection of the Southeasterly line of Kings Highway West with the Northwesterly line of Chews Landing Road, said point being corner to lands of the Borough of Haddonfield; thence

(1) South 54 degrees 22 minutes 25 seconds West along the Southeasterly line of Kings Highway West, 300.55 feet to a point; thence

(2) South 25 degrees 37 minutes 35 seconds East at right angles to Kings Highway West 120.68 feet to corner to other lands of John J. Litz and Caroline, His Wife; thence

(3) South 68 degrees 39 minutes 05 seconds East along said land of Litz, at right angles to Chews Landing Road, 171.43 feet to a point in the Northwesterly line of said Chews Landing Road; thence

(4) North 21 degrees 20 minutes 55 seconds East along the Northwesterly line of Chews Landing Road, 280.55 feet to corner to said lands of the Borough of Haddonfield; thence

(5) North 47 degrees 08 minutes 20 seconds West along said land of the Borough of Haddonfield, 58.67 feet to the point and place of BEGINNING.

BEING DESCRIBED in accordance with a survey made by Richard S. Humphries, P.L.S., dated April 20, 2007.

expected_closure.closure_notes: Significant misclosure (52 ft) despite this being a surveyed description (Richard S. Humphries P.L.S., April 20, 2007). The misclosure suggests either the legal description was transcribed with errors from the survey, or the survey was of the actual property lines which may not form a mathematically closed figure. This surveyed version differs from the older pre-survey version (7797) in call 1 bearing (S 54 vs S 64), call 1 distance (300.55 vs 229.89), call 4 distance (280.55 vs 279.48), and call 5 bearing and distance (N 47°08'20" W, 58.67 vs N 46°46'25" W, 59.30).
